title: Apple Inc. (AAPL) Shares Bought by MERIAN GLOBAL INVESTORS UK Ltd
text:
Posted by Shelly Janes on Jan 16th, 2019 // No Comments
MERIAN GLOBAL INVESTORS UK Ltd lifted its holdings in Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 3.5% in the third quarter, according to its most recent disclosure with the Securities & Exchange Commission. The fund owned 1,061,659 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock after buying an additional 36,321 shares during the quarter. Apple comprises 1.6% of MERIAN GLOBAL INVESTORS UK Ltd’s portfolio, making the stock its 15th biggest holding. MERIAN GLOBAL INVESTORS UK Ltd’s holdings in Apple were worth $239,658,000 as of its most recent SEC filing.
Several other institutional investors have also added to or reduced their stakes in AAPL. Delphi Private Advisors LLC bought a new stake in Apple during the 2nd quarter worth about $120,000. CX Institutional bought a new stake in Apple during the 2nd quarter worth about $135,000. Selective Wealth Management bought a new stake in Apple during the 3rd quarter worth about $194,000. Lawson Kroeker Investment Management Inc. NE bought a new stake in Apple during the 3rd quarter worth about $201,000. Finally, Boston Standard Wealth Management LLC bought a new stake in Apple during the 3rd quarter worth about $204,000. 57.04% of the stock is owned by institutional investors and hedge funds. In other Apple news, insider Chris Kondo sold 3,408 shares of the company’s stock in a transaction that occurred on Monday, November 19th. The stock was sold at an average price of $190.00, for a total transaction of $647,520.00. Following the completion of the transaction, the insider now owns 8,940 shares of the company’s stock, valued at approximately $1,698,600. The transaction was disclosed in a legal filing with the SEC, which is available at this hyperlink . Corporate insiders own 0.05% of the company’s stock.
NASDAQ:AAPL opened at $153.07 on Wednesday. Apple Inc. has a twelve month low of $142.00 and a twelve month high of $233.47. The company has a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.87, a current ratio of 1.12 and a quick ratio of 1.09. The company has a market cap of $748.53 billion, a price-to-earnings ratio of 12.85, a PEG ratio of 1.44 and a beta of 1.23.
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last released its quarterly earnings results on Thursday, November 1st. The iPhone maker reported $2.91 earnings per share for the quarter, topping analysts’ consensus estimates of $2.78 by $0.13. Apple had a return on equity of 48.68% and a net margin of 22.41%. The firm had revenue of $62.90 billion during the quarter, compared to the consensus estimate of $61.55 billion. During the same quarter in the prior year, the firm posted $2.07 EPS. The business’s revenue was up 19.6% on a year-over-year basis. On average, sell-side analysts forecast that Apple Inc. will post 12.1 earnings per share for the current fiscal year.
AAPL has been the subject of several analyst reports. Oppenheimer restated a “neutral” rating on shares of Apple in a research report on Monday, October 1st. Wells Fargo & Co set a $210.00 target price on Apple and gave the stock a “neutral” rating in a research report on Monday, October 1st. Macquarie restated a “buy” rating and set a $235.00 target price on shares of Apple in a research report on Thursday, September 27th. Nomura restated a “neutral” rating and set a $215.00 target price (up from $210.00) on shares of Apple in a research report on Friday, September 28th. Finally, Bank of America restated a “buy” rating on shares of Apple in a research report on Tuesday, October 9th. Three analysts have rated the stock with a sell rating, twenty-six have issued a hold rating and twenty-two have issued a buy rating to the company.
